label: revised
provider: Gemini OpenAI compatibility API (direct, same as production)
scope: Isolated model routing with the production prompt and parser; not tool execution, narration, or the deterministic fallback. Registry examples are in-distribution. Authored holdout is reported separately. Arguments use exact accepted values at their named keys; all annotated cases remain in the denominator. Invalid output and API errors never count as abstention.
